calienne_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.SYSTEM: The Completion Contract defines how calienne finishes every execution. It SHALL NOT perform reasoning or modify pipeline results. It SHALL ensure deterministic pipeline shutdown. Every execution SHALL terminate through this contract.
calienne_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.PHILOSOPHY: Every execution MUST end in a known state. Execution SHALL NEVER terminate unexpectedly. All runtime resources SHALL be released. All execution artifacts SHALL be finalized. Completion MUST be deterministic.
calienne_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.STATES: Valid completion states: SUCCESS, PARTIAL_SUCCESS, FAILED, CANCELLED, TIMEOUT, SECURITY_ABORT, SYSTEM_ABORT. Only one completion state may exist per execution.
calienne_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.PRE_COMPLETION: Verify, in order: pipeline state, decision contract, output schema, reasoning graph, execution passport, security status, resource status. If validation fails, return a failure contract.
calienne_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.RESOURCE_CLEANUP: Release, in order: active providers, streaming sessions, temporary memory, execution buffers, temporary files, locks, open handles. Never leave runtime resources active.
calienne_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.FINALIZATION: Finalize, in order: decision contract, reasoning graph, execution metrics, pipeline statistics, session summary, audit log. Never modify finalized artifacts.
calienne_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.STREAM_TERMINATION: Complete active streams. Emit exactly one terminal event: PIPELINE_COMPLETED or PIPELINE_ABORTED. Never emit multiple terminal events. Close the transport cleanly.
calienne_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.CHECKPOINTS: Persist: final checkpoint, decision contract, reasoning graph, execution timeline, runtime metrics, failure report (if applicable). The checkpoint becomes immutable.
calienne_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.SESSION_SUMMARY: Generate: execution_id, conversation_id, execution_mode, pipeline_duration, providers_used, agents_executed, claims_processed, reasoning_loops, warnings, errors, completion_state.
calienne_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.AUDIT: Finalize, in order: execution timeline, security audit, failure log, resource usage, performance metrics, pipeline history. Audit records SHALL be immutable.
calienne_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.POST_COMPLETION: After completion: no further reasoning, no new claims, no graph modifications, no pipeline restarts, no resource allocation. Execution is closed.
calienne_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.RETURN: Return to the Conversation Director: completion_state, decision_contract, output_payload, execution_summary, resource_summary, audit_reference, checkpoint_reference, runtime_metrics.
